blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-accessibility-1 (Delete action is a clickable div, unreachable with the keyboard) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it
R-accessibility-2 (Icon-only delete control has no accessible name) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: Render the delete action as a native `<button type="button" className="icon-button" onClick={onDelete}>`. A keyboard user pressing Tab never reaches the div (no tabindex), and Enter or Space does nothing (no key handler), so they cannot delete a document — the very task the change adds (WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard, 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value). A screen reader announces no role either. The native button brings focus, Enter/Space activation and the button role.
findings.title: Delete action is a clickable div, unreachable with the keyboard

findings.recommendation: Give the control a text name, e.g. `aria-label="Delete document"` on the button (or visually hidden text inside it). Its only content is `TrashIcon`, whose `<svg>` is `aria-hidden="true"` (src/components/icons.tsx:3), so a screen reader user reaching the control hears nothing (or just "button" once R-accessibility-1 is fixed) and cannot tell it deletes the document (WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content, 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value).
findings.title: Icon-only delete control has no accessible name

findings.recommendation: The avatar conveys who owns the document (per the component's doc comment), but the `` has no `alt`: a screen reader announces the image file name or URL instead of the owner, so screen reader users do not learn who owns the document (WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content). Pass the owner's name as a prop and set `alt={ownerName}` (e.g. "Owner: Jane Doe"); if the owner is shown as text elsewhere, use `alt=""` instead.
findings.title: Owner avatar image has no alt text

findings.recommendation: The `icon-button` style is not in the change and the trash icon is 16x16 (src/components/icons.tsx:3). Check that the control shows a visible focus indicator (WCAG 2.4.7 Focus Visible), that its target is at least 24x24 CSS pixels or spaced enough (WCAG 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum)), and that the icon stroke meets 3:1 against the toolbar background (WCAG 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast).
findings.title: Focus visibility and target size of the icon button not verifiable
